reviews.persona: field technician (HVAC service, 410A/R-22/R-32, TXV and piston, long line sets)
reviews.change: Correct the charge_adjust per-foot rates in the contract and kernel. 3.0 oz/ft for 3/8 in and 4.0 oz/ft for 1/2 in are several times too high. Typical liquid-line values are roughly 0.3 oz/ft for 1/4 in, 0.4 oz/ft for 5/16 in, 0.6 oz/ft for 3/8 in and 1.2 oz/ft for 1/2 in, and 1/4 in should not equal 5/16 in. As written, a 25 ft extension on 3/8 in would say to add about 75 oz when the right figure is about 15 oz, which badly overcharges the system. Then add tests with non-zero extra length.
